Explicitly restarted Krylov and interior eigenvalues Explicit restarting and shift-invert are compared using original eigenproblem residuals and counted operator actions. Assumptions, units and boundaries A fixed Dirichlet Laplacian of size 31, restart lengths 8 and 16, and at most 40 cycles. Compare the untransformed problem with shifts 0 and 950. Editorial clarification One eigenpair of a real symmetric matrix only. No implicit restarting, Krylov-Schur, locking, or general nonnormal or clustered-spectrum capability is claimed. Adopted numerical method Two-pass Arnoldi is explicitly restarted from one Ritz vector. Original LU routines perform the shifted solves, and stopping uses the original eigenproblem. lambdaj=4(n+1)2sin2(j∗pi/[2(n+1)])lambdaj​=4(n+1)2sin2(j∗pi/[2(n+1)]) T=(A−sigmaI)−1T=(A−sigmaI)−1 lambda=sigma+1/thetalambda=sigma+1/theta References and measured quantities The known discrete sine spectrum and an independent global LAPACK comparison.
